# The Seacoast Center for OCD & Anxiety

> A San Diego-based mental health practice specializing in OCD, anxiety disorders, PTSD, and trauma treatment using evidence-based therapies like EMDR.

The Seacoast Center for OCD & Anxiety, led by Jill Stoddard, serves San Diego County and Southern California with specialized mental health services. The practice focuses on anxiety management, trauma recovery, and stress coping strategies for diverse populations including military families and women.

## Key Topics

- OCD (Obsessive-Compulsive Disorder)
- Anxiety Disorders
- PTSD (Post-Traumatic Stress Disorder)
- EMDR (Eye Movement Desensitization and Reprocessing)
- Trauma Recovery
- Stress Management
- San Diego County
- Jill Stoddard
- Military Families
- Women's Mental Health
- Anxiety Management
- Trauma Responses
- UC San Diego Health

- [The Seacoast Center for OCD & Anxiety Blog](https://csamsandiego.com/blog): Mental health blog covering anxiety, OCD, EMDR, trauma, and stress management with evidence-based insights and coping strategies.
